stack_spec.name: Spec4
stack_spec.description: A locally-served, developer-facing pipeline app (Dash + Dash Mantine Components) that turns a rough idea or existing codebase into a versioned folder of specs; this round reworks its shell and project view into a dense, developer-tool UI with a single accent color and no marketing-site chrome.

languages.name: Python
languages.role: Dash application server, callbacks, and UI layout composition (backend and server-rendered UI are one deployable)
languages.trailing_commas: in multi-line collections and function calls

languages.name: CSS
languages.role: shell, theme, and project-view spacing/density styling; hand-authored, no preprocessor, no new build tooling
languages.quotes: double (for consistency with the rest of the codebase)

naming_conventions.files: snake_case (v3.css retained as the single stylesheet)

targets.name: spec4_app
targets.purpose: the single local Dash application: serves the UI (status bar, project view, round tree, agent rows) and runs the pipeline-agent backend in one process
targets.runtime: Python 3.12, served via gunicorn (production-style local serving) or the Dash dev server (DASH_DEBUG=true)
targets.hosting: local machine only, at localhost:8050; no cloud hosting, no multi-tenant deployment
targets.distribution: run locally via the `spec4` CLI entrypoint, `uv run python src/spec4/app.py`, or gunicorn per the existing Makefile `deploy` target

exposure.transport: HTTP on localhost only; not exposed beyond the local machine

libraries.name: Dash
libraries.purpose: core web application framework serving both the UI and its server-side callbacks; unchanged this round

libraries.name: Dash Mantine Components
libraries.purpose: the sole UI component layer; this round's shell/status-bar/tree/rows are built entirely from DMC primitives with the accent set once as the theme primary — no React, Tailwind, or other new front-end dependency is introduced

libraries.name: dash-iconify
libraries.purpose: icon components used in place of the removed emoji throughout the shell and rows

libraries.name: litellm
libraries.purpose: multi-provider LLM gateway used by the seven pipeline agents; unchanged this round, referenced only for the default provider/model shown in the status bar

libraries.name: mcp
libraries.purpose: Model Context Protocol client SDK used elsewhere in the pipeline; unchanged this round

libraries.name: boto3
libraries.purpose: AWS SDK supporting litellm's optional Bedrock/SageMaker routing; unchanged this round

libraries.name: httpx
libraries.purpose: general HTTP client used across the app; unchanged this round

libraries.name: jsonschema
libraries.purpose: validates artifact JSON files against their schemas

libraries.name: gunicorn
libraries.purpose: production-style WSGI server for local deployment

libraries.name: pyyaml
libraries.purpose: YAML parsing used elsewhere in the pipeline

libraries.name: mypy
libraries.purpose: strict static type checking across the codebase

libraries.name: types-pyyaml
libraries.purpose: type stubs for pyyaml, required for mypy strict mode

libraries.name: pytest
libraries.purpose: test runner for the existing suite (agents, layouts, callbacks, session, project-manager)

libraries.name: pytest-cov
libraries.purpose: coverage measurement for the pytest suite

libraries.name: Playwright
libraries.purpose: browser automation for end-to-end verification of the reworked shell and project view

libraries.name: Ruff
libraries.purpose: linting (and formatting via ruff format) for all Python source

artifact_store.choice: local filesystem JSON files under .spec4/v{N}/, one file per artifact, produced by the pipeline agents
artifact_store.purpose: source of truth for every Artifact and UsageRecord this round's screens read; read fresh from disk on every render so status is never stale
artifact_store.durability: source of truth for artifact content; survives restarts and is unaffected by browser state; the round tree and cost figure are only as current as this round's last agent run

collections.name: round_artifacts
physical: one file per artifact under .spec4/v{N}/, path fixed by pipeline order; status derived live from the existing dependency graph (mtime comparison against upstream artifacts)

collections.name: usage_records
collections.purpose: per-round usage/cost rollup; deliberately excluded from the artifact dependency graph and never marked needs-update
physical: usage.json, one per round, per-agent model/tokens/cost totals

browser_store.choice: existing browser dcc.Store pair — sessionStorage (session) and localStorage (prefs); no server-side session
browser_store.purpose: remembers the working directory and default provider/model across navigations and, for prefs, across browser sessions on the same machine, without any state touching the server or disk
browser_store.durability: session store is cleared when the tab closes (not durable); prefs store persists on-device across sessions but is not backed up or synced

collections.name: prefs_store
physical: localStorage, read via callback State; BYOK provider keys live here client-side only and never reach the server or disk

patterns: Dash Mantine Components remains the sole UI/component layer for this round; no React, Tailwind, or other new front-end dependency is introduced
layout helpers in layouts/_shared.py (e.g. _card, cost_summary_card) are reused rather than duplicated
agent pipeline order is defined once in app_constants.AGENT_KEYS; all agent-ordered tables (round tree, agent rows) are derived from or asserted against it
status (artifact presence/staleness, agent action, cost) is recomputed from the existing dependency graph and usage.json on every render, never cached
existing component ids are kept as a test contract; new components get new ids rather than renaming existing ones
the accent color is set once as the Mantine theme primary; components inherit it rather than setting color locally
documentation: design decisions recorded as numbered comments (D-XX) at the point of implementation, per existing convention

project_structure.purpose: Dash Mantine layout components; this round's shell, status bar, project view, round tree, and agent rows are built here
reusable layout helpers (cards, cost summary) shared across screens
Dash server-side callbacks; new callbacks for the round tree and agent rows read working directory/round/provider state via State from the existing browser stores
single stylesheet; this round's theme primary, spacing, and removal of marketing-era styling (grid background, gradients, hover glows) lands here
existing artifact dependency graph, staleness detection, and agent button state; the round tree and agent rows read status and actions from here unchanged
session defaults and artifact persistence; source of working-directory and round state
per-agent model resolution shared by the gate card, model chip, and retry panel; status bar reads the default provider/model from here
single source of the seven-agent pipeline order (AGENT_KEYS)
pytest suite mirroring src/ layout; includes callback co-presence and component-ordering contract tests that must keep passing through this round's layout changes
